source.name: Aghanims Shard
source.description:
Magic Regen +75%.
The carrier permanently gains a random enemy chess pieces active skill as an additional skill.
source.lore: With origins known only to a single wizard, fragments of this impossible crystal are nearly as coveted as the renowned scepter itself.
notes: The carrier must have mana for Aghanims Shard.
Additional skill will be removed after chess pieces upgraded.
